ssid.description: The Service Set Identifier (SSID) of the Wi-Fi network.

password.description: The pre-shared key (password) for the network. Empty string indicates an open network.

enc_type.description: The security encryption type. Common values: WPA, WPA2, WPA3, WEP, nopass.

gui_tool.description: The GUI dialog tool to use for generating QR codes or scanning. Supported: zenity, kdialog.

webcam_device.description: The device file path for the webcam used in QR scanning modes (-w).

scan_file.description: Path to an image file containing a QR code to be scanned and auto-connected (-f, -p).

legacy_mode.description: Enable legacy encoding mode (-L) for compatibility with older devices.

networks.description: A list of network configurations to manage. Used for batch operations or multi-network configs.

networks.items.description: A single network entry in the networks list. This is a flat map of fields, not a nested schema object in the values_schema structure.

networks.items.ssid.description: SSID for the specific network item.

networks.items.password.description: Password for the specific network item.

networks.items.enc_type.description: Encryption type for the specific network item.
